owner_creation.analysis: FILE:src/ifile.rs: Each allocated ifile owns saved filename/realpath strings, copied screen position and links; filestate and alternate-stream fields connect to separate ch/edit owners.
owner_creation.invariant: List nodes distinguish owned strings from attached resources.
limitations: The retained stdin disposal fix is preserved and its findings remain open; this is not a full ch/edit/mark lifetime qualification.

aliases_escapes.analysis: FILE:src/ifile.rs: get_ifile and accessors return raw node/string/state pointers; h_hold is only an integer count, and del_ifile itself does not enforce that borrowed handles have retired.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Node deletion requires all outside aliases to be retired.
limitations: The retained stdin disposal fix is preserved and its findings remain open; this is not a full ch/edit/mark lifetime qualification.

callback_targets.analysis: FILE:src/ifile.rs: mark_check_ifile, unmark and dispose_ifile_state are direct calls; they can mutate related mark/input state before a node is unlinked.
callback_targets.invariant: Cross-module hooks must respect list mutation order.
limitations: The retained stdin disposal fix is preserved and its findings remain open; this is not a full ch/edit/mark lifetime qualification.

invalidation.analysis: FILE:src/ifile.rs: find_ifile can free/replace h_filename for a shorter alias; del_ifile retires current/old aliases, marks and filestate before freeing node/name storage.
invalidation.invariant: Filename and node borrowers must not span replacement.
limitations: The retained stdin disposal fix is preserved and its findings remain open; this is not a full ch/edit/mark lifetime qualification.

mutation_commit.analysis: FILE:src/ifile.rs: new_ifile allocates node/names before linking, while find_ifile frees an old name before save allocates the replacement; metadata is raw and not failure-transactional.
mutation_commit.invariant: Linked and replaced owners need separate commit contracts.
limitations: The retained stdin disposal fix is preserved and its findings remain open; this is not a full ch/edit/mark lifetime qualification.

release_pair.analysis: FILE:src/ifile.rs: Deletion frees h_rfilename, h_filename and p after disposal/unlink; altpipe and altfilename need their edit-side cleanup and cannot be assumed released by these three frees.
release_pair.invariant: Every attached owner needs its own release path.
limitations: The retained stdin disposal fix is preserved and its findings remain open; this is not a full ch/edit/mark lifetime qualification.

error_cleanup.analysis: FILE:src/ifile.rs: Fatal allocation during partial node/name construction or name replacement may enter cleanup with incomplete owners; no RAII rollback exists in this C-shaped descriptor.
error_cleanup.invariant: Allocation failure cannot be assumed to retire all aliases.
limitations: The retained stdin disposal fix is preserved and its findings remain open; this is not a full ch/edit/mark lifetime qualification.

signals_handoff.analysis: FILE:src/ifile.rs: List/count/index mutations are ordinary raw global writes; asynchronous quit or other handlers have no exclusion protocol around them.
signals_handoff.invariant: M0-MEM-001 keeps the whole file hazard-recorded.
limitations: The retained stdin disposal fix is preserved and its findings remain open; this is not a full ch/edit/mark lifetime qualification.
